mxCell.value:
Ctrl+D: discrete input
F2: speed keypad
Ctrl+T: toggle pushbutton
Shift+F3: counter script
F4: show overlay window
Tab moves the focus between touch objects, Enter activates the focused object.
Links that meta2d has and InTouch does not, configured in the same Animation Links dialog (Animation, Actions and Scripts groups).
Status 0..3: colour, label and blink per state
Opacity follows Level; flip and dash by expression
Gauge value and trend series from links
Fan spins at Rpm; glow, pulse, shake by tags
Bounce, sway, fade, blink, colour cycle, custom
While FlowOn; dash speed and direction by expression
Data change counts Status changes; condition on Temp
Open URL, send message, control animations
Touch Options and new script functions
Confirmation before acting; scripts can open URLs, show messages, control animations
Smooth changes, blended colours, alarm markers, tooltip trends, data age and regular expression states (INTOUCH_LINKS.md section 13). Page-wide options are in Screen Settings, Runtime.
Step jumps every 2.5 s; right: Smooth Changes 800 ms
Break points green 0, yellow 50, red 100; Level as value
Warning triangle while in alarm; blinks until acknowledged

Temp has value alarms (Lo 25, Hi 80, HiHi 100): orange for medium, red for high severity. HighAlarm is a boolean alarm. Acknowledge in the alarm list of the status bar to stop the blinking. Screen Settings, Runtime, "Alarm markers on objects" adds markers to every object of the page.
Rest the mouse on an object to see its recent values
Left: 60 s of Level with a fixed text. Right: 30 s of the first tag of the tooltip expression (Temp).
Stale after 5 s: grey colour or the "stale" state
Left: Sensor updates every 8 s, so it shows NO DATA for 3 s of every 8. Right: the colour link turns grey 5 s after the last press of Update.
Top: red for any message with "alarm", orange with "warn". Bottom: /^auto/i and /^man/i on Mode, ignoring case.

Bindings, keyframes, event handlers, security, hover halo, object triggers and state machines, and media are links of the Animation Links dialog (INTOUCH_LINKS.md section 12.1). Page triggers are in Screen Settings, Page Triggers.
Label, colour map, level, tooltip, rotation
The needle: Angle scaled to 0..360 deg. Rest on the tank for its tooltip.
Frames with autoplay, a colour cycle, a chain
Double-click Click +1 for a message. The ping label resets after 1.5 s.
Roles hide or disable an object
Without roles the first button is hidden and the second disabled. Add &hmi-role=engineer,operator to the Run Screen URL to use both. A list of roles needs all of them.
Point at each button; press for the stronger look
Actions run when the conditions become true, else actions when they become false. Pressure: deadband 2, on delay 300 ms, blinks while out of range.
The first matching state is entered and its actions run once on entry. The last state has no conditions (or the always true operator).
Plays while MediaOn; muted, unmute in the player
Media link: play while true (mode play) or pause while true (mode pause). Stop also rewinds with an Animation/Media Control link.
The trigger belongs to the page, not to an object: it changes the banner when Temp passes 80 and back below 78. Edit it in Screen Settings, Page Triggers.
Each state lights its lamp on entry. Edit it in Screen Settings, Page Triggers.
